tests.notes: 13468 tests passed. The two remaining failures are pre-existing home-directory assertions in sitrep-template.test.js and purser/template-command.test.ts: each first requires homedir() output and then forbids the literal path of this operator's actual home directory. Four feature-specific contract failures found by this run were corrected and their seven exact gates pass.

validation.manualVerification: macOS Screen Recording and Accessibility permission blocked an automated click-through capture of the live GPUI framebuffer. The checked-in proof therefore uses pd-console's real Block projection against the live development daemon at 520px; the HTML-only layout-overflow checker cannot geometrically inspect a native GPUI or PNG surface. A reviewer should click an active row in a permitted build and confirm that Mission chat reaches the selected actor. The full Node inventory ran under the repository's Node 22 ABI; its feature-specific contract findings were fixed and rechecked. Hosted review additionally found that a saved conversation could silently resolve through another surviving berth; the selection file now preserves both session and berth identity, and a five-test Rust suite proves chat remains unbound until the operator confirms that switch. Legacy session-only selection files are also inspect-only until the operator confirms the owning berth.

risks.description: The selected-actor routing compiled and its identity projection is unit-tested, but macOS privacy controls prevented automated end-to-end clicking in the live GPUI window; a permitted human click-through remains the first review check.

The current workspace Cargo.lock is stale relative to dependencies already present on main. Cargo compilation passed after resolving that pre-existing graph, and the unrelated lock rewrite was excluded from this change.
Provider labels remain unknown when no daemon roster witness exists; this is deliberate fail-closed behavior but may look less polished than guessed labels until every harness publishes evidence.
